sa818s_v.notes: Stock zero. Pre-order is required. Final quotation and exact lead time are confirmed only after pre-order; over 18 working days triggers continue/cancel-and-refund confirmation. The integer lead-time field records the conservative upper end of the stated typical working-day range. Standard-PCBA installation and any extra service charge were not explicitly confirmed.

dual_module_job.notes: Supplier asked whether both C-numbers were intended for one reference designator. They are not: Leshy2 uses two separate reference designators and independent RF paths, so an explicit answer for the actual job remains open.

j4_f_operations.description: install, strain-route and continuity-test five TE Connectivity 2118651-2 microcoax jumpers
assemble the two-board sandwich and enclosure
execute the supplied whole-device functional-test procedure
required_fixtures_or_files: customer-supplied test procedure uploaded through PCBA Advanced Options
j4_f_operations.notes: Function Test is selectable, but JLCPCB engineers review feasibility and final quotation manually only after order placement. This is not pre-order acceptance of the requested whole-device test.

j4_p_operations.description: compatibility-test and pack M5Stack U214 Cap LoRa-1262 separately
pack ten labelled external antennas as a kit
pack two exact protected XTAR 18650 4000 mAh 10 A cells separately for user installation
j4_p_operations.requirements_or_exclusions: JLCPCB reports no suitable shipping channel for products containing batteries or other powered components and declines PCBA assembly service for the protected cells.
j4_p_operations.notes: Cells remain separately sourced and user-installed; no battery purchase or shipment is authorized.

destination_restrictions: JLCPCB currently has no suitable shipping channel for products containing batteries or other powered components
battery_shipping.notes: Project owner confirmed that accumulator cells are not part of device delivery. The user supplies and installs compatible protected cells separately; this is no longer a supplier gate.
